priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target.
Use stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Black Arrow whenever available, anticipating a guaranteed proc immediately after every Rapid Fire.
Cast Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots stacks and activate Trick Shots.
Cast Multi-Shot immediately after every Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire to maintain Trick Shots and spend Precise Shots.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff would expire before you can finish an Aimed Shot cast.
Activate Trueshot and immediately use the granted Black Arrow proc.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus and reduce the cooldown of Aimed Shot.
Cast Multi-Shot to maintain the Trick Shots buff if it is not active and you are about to cast Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire
Cast Aimed Shot if you are about to reach 2 charges
Cast Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots procs
Cast Steady Shot if you have no other actions available and need Focus
